# Real Open Food Facts records

Responses from the Open Food Facts API v2, fetched on 2026-11-22 with the app's own field list (`src/off/fields.ts`). Each file's `_note` gives its source.

Data: Open Food Facts contributors, under the [Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). These are small extracts used only for tests. Product names and brands are as entered on Open Food Facts.

They were chosen to cover:

| File | What it covers |
| --- | --- |
| `noodle-kit-…` | A UPC-A code (the API documentation's example product) |
| `cola-330ml-…` | An EAN-13 drink, the E150d caramel colour |
| `cola-zero-…` | Sweeteners, including E951 aspartame |
| `hazelnut-spread-…` | High sugar and high saturated fat |
| `rolled-oats-…` | A single-ingredient product |
| `cola-12oz-can-upce-…` | A UPC-E code; sodium entered in g instead of mg |
| `diet-cola-12oz-can-upce-…` | A UPC-E code with no ingredients and no categories |
